lessons.title: Ask about preferences
lessons.prompt: 客人说想要一款白葡萄酒。用英语确认风格和预算。
lessons.model: What style of white wine do you usually enjoy? Would you prefer something light and crisp, or something richer? Do you have a price range in mind?
checks: 询问了风格，而不是替客人假设
可以不看文字完整表达

lessons.title: Describe a wine
lessons.prompt: 练习描述一款干型、高酸、带柑橘香气的轻酒体白葡萄酒。只用已给信息，不猜酒款。
lessons.model: This is a dry, light-bodied white wine with bright acidity and citrus aromas. It feels fresh and lively on the palate.
checks: 明确描述甜度、酒体和酸度
没有凭空补充产区、年份或酿造信息

lessons.title: Explain your conclusion
lessons.prompt: 用英语说明初步判断，同时保留不确定性：高酸、柑橘与绿色水果，可能来自凉爽气候，但单凭这些无法确定品种。
lessons.model: The high acidity and the citrus and green-fruit aromas suggest a cool-climate style. However, these features alone do not identify the grape variety. I would compare the texture, alcohol and other aroma markers before making my final conclusion.
checks: 区分了可能性与确定结论
